# Sparkline

A word-sized trend: plays per week over the last 12 weeks, drawn as a thin neutral line with the latest point emphasised, and the low and high points revealed…

`SongNodes.Sparkline` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Sparkline values={…} labels={…} measure="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Sparkline" values="{{…}}" labels="{{…}}" measure="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (SparklineProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` * | `number[]` | Values oldest first (12 weeks). |
| `labels` * | `string[]` | Week-start labels for the low/high tip ("3 Aug"). |
| `measure` * | `string` | What is counted, for the accessible sentence ("Plays per week"). |
| `size` | `"table" \| "tile"` | Size preset: table 96×22, tile 132×32. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | Show the latest value beside the line. Default true. |
| `focusable` | `boolean` | Focusable (figure tiles); table rows leave it false. |
